hook: Write Postgres extensions in plain Go

beats.say: gopgext builds PostgreSQL extensions from ordinary Go code using TinyGo. Mark a function with a comment directive and it becomes a SQL function.
It writes the C glue, the install script and the control file for you. Much of the standard library works, and strings, arrays, timestamps, UUIDs and JSON map to SQL types.
The author warns it is experimental: a bug runs inside the database server, where it can crash it or corrupt data.
